'''Shesharile 6''' was one of the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] orbiting a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Shesharile system/Legends|Shesharile system]], located in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. It was the only populated moon of the [[Star system/Legends|system]] alongside [[Shesharile 5]].<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref>

==Description==
Heavily-settled, the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was thickly overlaind with industry. Despite this, as of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] such industry was considered to be outdated, with the world's economy being kept alive mainly by the cheap cost of labor.<ref name="GG6" />

Shesharile 6 was extremely dirty, so much that it was considered impossible to escape the filth and pollution when visiting it. The entire moon was considered a 'garbage-[[Planet/Legends|planet]]', becoming almost unbearable due to the smell produced by the first spring heat activating the [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]] in the underground waste-sinks.<ref name="GG6" />

[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Callista Ming]], at some point in her travels, stopped at Shesharile 6.<ref name="Murder in Slushtime">{{JournalCite|14|Murder in Slushtime}}</ref>

==History==
===Before the decline===
Before the construction of the [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star II]] had begun, [[Shesharile system/Legends|Shesharile]] was a thriving industrial and commercial system. The entirety of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] was full of life and activity. Most of Shesharile 6 and [[Shesharile 5|5]]'s exports were to the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial military]], especially in the form of ammunition.<ref name="GG6" />

===After the decline===
When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] began to divert its resources towards the building of a [[Death Star II/Legends|second]] [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] battlestation, some of the minor industries that used to supply conventional weaponry were left behind. Exports from the remote [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] were not considered worth spending [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|money]] on anymore and the [[Shesharile system/Legends|Shesharile system]], which mainly supplied ammunitions, saw all of his deals with the Empire terminated. The Imperial pullout quickly destroyed the [[Star system/Legends|system]]'s economy, starting the greatest depression the Cluster had ever seen.<ref name="GG6" />

==Society==
Both Shesharile 6 and [[Shesharile 5|5]] were ruled by the same [[Star system/Legends|system]]-wide government.<ref name="GG6" />

===After the decline===
With the depression, criminal gangs took control of various city governments. During this dark period, the [[Moon/Legends|moon]]'s largest [[City/Legends|city]] was controlled by [[Crime lord/Legends|underworld leader]] [[Yerkys ne Dago]].<ref name="GG6" />

The [[Shesharile system/Legends|system]] as a whole saw an enormous increase in drugrunning, with a variety of narcotics becoming the new major exports of the world. The discovery of a new addictive [[Fungus/Legends|fungi]] by [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Shlith-dan]] only worsened the moon's decline.<ref name="GG6" />

The value of the [[Star system/Legends|system]]'s own currency saw a depreciation of 98%, with many [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] insisting upon being paid in [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Imperial credits]] or precious [[Metal/Legends|metals]] instead.<ref name="GG6" />
